label: PF Backlog 111
title: Phase 1.5: Business, Market & Monetization (stages 0b-0e, gated)
body:
New phase after 0a, before design (1). Stages (each gated):
0b Business & Product Definition - MAIN product-owner; artifact business-brief.md (vision, target customers, JTBD, value prop, success metrics, AI-integration recommendation).
0c Market, Competition & Positioning - MAIN researcher + scout, analyst; artifact market-analysis.md (TAM/SAM/SOM, competitors, positioning, differentiation, alignment).
0d Monetization & Unit Economics - MAIN pricing-strategist [NEW] + finops; artifact monetization.md (revenue model, pricing, unit economics, cost, profit, forecast).
0e Go-to-Market & Customer Journey - MAIN marketing [promoted] + growth [NEW], customer-onboarding; artifact gtm-plan.md.
depends_on: 0b<-0a, 0c<-0b, 0d<-0b,0c, 0e<-0b,0c,0d; 1.depends_on += 0e. Model class: 0b/0c/0d=R, 0e=G.
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).

dashboard_impact.reason: New business phase needs its own views/artifacts in the dashboard.
